company.name: Atlassian
company.shortDescription: Atlassian is a software company that offers proprietary software products for teamwork, project management, and software development.
company.description: Atlassian produces software that helps teams work together more efficiently and effectively. The company provides project planning and management software, collaboration tools and IT help desk solutions. The company operates in four segments: subscriptions (term licenses and cloud agreements), maintenance (annual maintenance contracts that provide support and periodic updates and are generally attached to perpetual license sales), perpetual license (upfront sale for indefinite usage of the software), and other (training, strategic consulting, and revenue from the Atlassian Marketplace app store).

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $150,000,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $400,000,000 to $3,300,000,000, a 8.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
